webui.General.MaxStepsHint: How many model requests one turn may make. Used when the step limit mode is not no limit.
webui.General.StepLimitHint: No step limit runs the turn until the model answers. Ask to continue offers another equal budget. Stop the turn ends it with the answer collected so far.
webui.General.StepLimitFieldHint: What happens when the model exhausts the step budget
webui.General.LifetimeHint: A temporary session expires after this many hours without activity. Persistent sessions never expire.
webui.General.LifetimeFieldHint: Default directory session expires after inactivity
webui.Sessions.Intro: Sessions are bound to a directory and inherited by subdirectories. Temporary sessions expire after {hours} hours of inactivity; persistent sessions never expire. Subagent sessions live under their parent and are deleted with it.
webui.Sessions.DeleteConfirm: Delete '{name}' and its message history? Sub-sessions are deleted with it.
webui.Plugins.InstallHint: Provide a direct link to a plugin .zip archive. Before installation, cdx verifies the archive layout, manifest.json schema, version compatibility, and JS syntax.
webui.Plugins.NoTools: This plugin does not register LLM tools.
webui.Live.Title: Live session
webui.Live.IntroRunning: The running turn updates here every second. Only the newest messages are shown; open the full history for everything else.
webui.Live.IntroIdle: No turn is running. The newest messages are shown; open the full history for everything else.
permissions.ReadToolsDetails: Read tools inspect files without changing them: read_file, list_dir, grep, glob. allow runs them silently, ask confirms every call, deny blocks them.
permissions.EditToolsDetails: Edit tools create and change files: write_file, edit_file. allow runs them silently, ask confirms every call, deny blocks them.
permissions.DangerousToolsDetails: Dangerous tools run commands on the machine: shell. allow runs them silently, ask confirms every command, deny blocks them.
permissions.OutsideDetails: ask shows a confirmation for every action that reaches outside the working folder, allow skips that confirmation, and deny blocks such actions. Deny is not a sandbox: commands, symlinks, and absolute paths can still leave the folder, so run cdx in an isolated environment when a hard limit is required.
permissions.OutsideHint: Ask, allow, or deny actions that leave the working folder
permissions.OutsideFieldHint: Deny is not a sandbox; run cdx in an isolated environment for a hard limit.
permissions.ResetConfirm: Clear all remembered always, session, and daemon permission grants?
permissions.GrantsHint: Grants remembered after answering a permission prompt: always is stored in the plugin config, daemon lasts until the daemon stops, session lasts for one session.
presets.Intro: A preset changes how the agent behaves and answers. The list of tools and environment are collected automatically on every request.
presets.Name: Name
presets.DescriptionHint: One line telling when to use this preset
presets.PromptHint: The explaining part of the system prompt
providers.Intro: A provider holds the connection: address, protocol and key. Models belong to a provider and differ only in their own settings.
providers.NoModels: This provider has no models yet.
providers.Name: Name
providers.KeepKey: Leave blank to keep existing encrypted key
providers.ModelNameHint: Unique across all providers, used by --model and in history.
providers.ContextHint: Uses the provider value when available, otherwise 128000.
providers.MaxOutputHint: Uses the provider value when available, otherwise 4096.
providers.TemperatureHint: Lower is more predictable, higher is more creative.
providers.ReasoningLevelsHint: Comma separated, in order from weak to strong.
providers.UseDefaultHint: One model is the default for the whole program.
providers.SendReasoningHint: Only when the provider accepts the parameter.
providers.SkipTemperatureHint: Needed when the provider rejects the parameter.

mcp.ReconnectTitle: Reconnect to every server and read its tool catalog again
mcp.EmptyBefore: No MCP servers yet. Add one with its command, such as
mcp.ServerIdHint: Used in tool names and permission rules; cannot change later
mcp.Name: Name
mcp.TransportHint: A local program or an HTTP endpoint
mcp.EndpointHint: The MCP endpoint, for example https://mcp.example.com/mcp
mcp.HeadersHint: One KEY=VALUE per line, stored as plain values
mcp.SecretHeadersHint: Stored in the encrypted secrets; leave a value blank to keep the saved one
mcp.CommandHint: The program cdx starts, for example npx
mcp.WorkdirHint: Empty uses the session working directory
mcp.EnvironmentHint: One KEY=VALUE per line, stored as plain values
mcp.ExposureHint: Automatic uses direct tools up to 20 per server and the gateway tool above that
mcp.PermissionHint: Overrides the level derived from tool annotations
mcp.EnabledHint: A disabled server stays in the list, but cdx does not start it and does not offer its tools to the model
mcp.EmptyCatalog: The catalog is empty. Connect or refresh the server to read its tools.
mcp.ImportHint: Paste the file used by Claude Desktop or Cursor. Values from env and headers are moved into the encrypted secrets; review the commands before saving.
mcp.InvalidJson: The text is not valid JSON.
mcp.ReplaceHint: Existing servers with the same id are replaced by the imported entry.

mcpserver.Title: MCP Endpoint
mcpserver.Description: Serves this daemon's tools to other agents over the Model Context Protocol
mcpserver.Schema.Title: MCP server
mcpserver.Schema.EnabledHint: Lets another agent call this daemon's tools over HTTP with a client token
mcpserver.EnabledHint: Lets another agent call this daemon's tools over HTTP with a client token
mcpserver.ClientsHint: Each token belongs to one client. Permissions apply on every call, and a denied class is not advertised to the client.
mcpserver.TokenOnce: The token is shown once. Copy it into the client configuration.
mcpserver.TokenOnceHint: Only the client id stays visible and the secret cannot be recovered.
mcpserver.NoClients: No client has a token yet.
mcpserver.RevokeConfirm: Revoke the token of {name}? The client loses access immediately.
mcpserver.ClassReadHint: Read tools run without a question.
mcpserver.ApprovalsHint: A call that needs an approval waits here. Approve the exact command, and the client retries the tool.
mcpserver.ClassTaskHint: Lets the client start a background task that this daemon's own model runs.
mcpserver.Schema.RemoteRootHint: Directory for task working directories; empty uses the daemon state directory
mcpserver.Schema.TaskPresetsHint: Comma separated preset names a client may ask for; the first one is the default
mcpserver.AskNote: An "ask" class on the Permissions page becomes a denial for an MCP call, because no terminal is attached there. Allow the class there as well.
